title: Lodhi Dynasty Sikander Lodhi
definition: Sikander Lodhi (reigned 1489–1517) was the most capable ruler of the Afghan Lodhi dynasty, known for consolidating the Delhi Sultanate, shifting the capital to Agra, and implementing rigorous administrative and religious reforms.
importanceInUpsc: Sikander Lodhi is a high-frequency topic in Medieval History, specifically regarding his administrative innovations (Gaj-i-Sikandari), urban planning (founding of Agra), and his complex religious policies which are often compared with later Mughal rulers.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Lodhi Dynasty Sikander Lodhi.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Afghan tribal structure of the Delhi Sultanate
